page.title: Homey
page.emptyBody: Pin a device, a flow or a webhook from Homey. The button runs it immediately.
page.askAdmin: An administrator connects Homey under Settings → Modules → Homey.
page.readOnly: You can see the buttons, but not use them.
page.flowsUnavailable: Flows were not read. The API key needs access to flows.
alert.title: Someone is ringing
alert.body: There is someone at the door.
settings.title: Homey
settings.heading: Connection
settings.intro: The address and API key stay on this server. The key is never shown again.
settings.tokenHint: Leave this empty to keep the key that is already stored.
settings.savedOffline: Saved, but Homey did not answer.
settings.disconnected: Connection removed. Buttons stay until Homey is connected again.
settings.where: Create the key in Homey under Settings → API keys. It needs device read and control, and flow start if flows should be pinned.
settings.ringIntro: When someone presses the doorbell, the tablet puts a card over the screen for 30 seconds. Paste the address into a Homey flow that calls it with GET when the bell rings. The address is shown only now.
settings.ringReady: A doorbell address is stored. Create a new one if you no longer have it.
settings.ringStale: This server is still running the previous version. Run the install command on the Pi again, then reload this page.
settings.cameraHint: The picture comes from the UniFi camera in Homey and refreshes while the card is up. The test does not press the doorbell or start the chimes.
settings.cameraEmpty: Homey has no doorbell or camera with a picture.
settings.streamHint: Only if Homey has no picture. An http or https address, such as MJPEG or MP4. RTSP does not play in the browser.
settings.ringTested: The card shows the camera picture for 30 seconds. It refreshes while the card is up. The doorbell and the chimes are not used.
settings.ringTestedUrl: The card shows the saved video address for 30 seconds. The doorbell and the chimes are not used.
settings.ringTestedNone: The card is up, but Homey has no picture from the camera.
reason.forbidden: You do not have access to Homey.
reason.admin_required: Only an administrator can change the connection.
reason.ring_missing: There is no doorbell address yet.
reason.store: The doorbell address could not be saved. The Homey gateway cannot write its data folder.
reason.stream: The video stream did not start.
reason.stream.noroute: There is no route to the stream.
reason.stream.type: That address did not return a video or a camera image.
reason.csrf: The security token was missing. Reload the page.
reason.homey_unreachable.timeout: The machine running Yuvomi got no answer from Homey. That address is on your home network, and this server is somewhere else. Run Yuvomi on a computer on the same network as Homey.
reason.homey_unreachable.noroute: This server has no route to Homey. Run Yuvomi on a computer on the same network as Homey.
reason.homey_unreachable.refused: The address answered, but Homey's API port refused the connection. Use the Homey Pro address, with http:// in front.
reason.invalid: Something in the form is invalid.
reason.limit: You have pinned as many buttons as the module accepts.
reason.address.loopback: That address points at this machine. Use Homey's address on the network.
reason.address.scheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.
reason.address.userinfo: The address cannot contain a username or password.
reason.address.resolve: The address did not resolve. Use Homey's IP address.
reason.address.path: Use only the Homey address, without a path or query.
